title: The Speeder Bike Chase
description: THE SPEEDER BIKE CHASE in RETURN OF THE JEDI was a heart-pumping, non-stop action sequence that took dozens of crafts people months of time and effort. In a Ralph McQuarrie production painting (front), Luke Slywalker races ahead of Imperial scouts on the antigravity bike at a speed of 200 miles an hour. In its various Incarnations, the vehicle was a rocket-powered scooter, souped-up hot rod and heavy-duty motorcycle.
